description:

**Job Description**
 Embrace a rewarding career as a Field Sales Executive with Rentokil PCI in the bustling city of Bhiwandi. We are on the lookout for dynamic individuals with 0\-5 years of experience to join our team and contribute to the growth of our leading pest control solutions. As a Field Sales Executive, you'll play a pivotal role in expanding our customer base and promoting our innovative pest control services.

 Conducting field visits in Bhiwandi and surrounding areas
   

  

 Effectively presenting and promoting Rentokil PCI's pest control solutions

 Staying updated on industry trends and competitor activities
   

  

**Skills And Qualifications**
 Strong communication and interpersonal skills
   

  

 0\-5 years of proven sales experience
   

  

 Ability to work independently and collaboratively
   

  

 Knowledge of pest control solutions is advantageous
   

  

 If you have a passion for sales and making a positive impact, apply now to be a part of Rentokil PCI's success story!

 Q: Is there a specific qualification needed for this role?
   

  

 A: While there's no specific qualification mentioned, candidates with knowledge of pest control solutions are preferred.
   

  

 Q: What is the salary range for the Field Sales Executive role?
   

  

 A: The salary details are not disclosed at the moment.
   

  

 Q: How will performance be evaluated in this role?
   

  

 A: Performance will be assessed based on meeting and exceeding sales targets, building effective customer relationships, and contributing to overall business growth.
   

  

 Q: Are there opportunities for career growth within Rentokil PCI?
   

  

 A: Yes, Rentokil PCI is committed to providing opportunities for career advancement and professional development. Join us and grow your career in the pest control industry.

title: Business Development Executive (Fresher)
description:
**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site Business Development Executive (Fresher) role based in Kalyan Dombivli. The role involves identifying potential clients in the chemical, petrochemical, refinery, and oil \& gas sectors, and supporting new business development efforts. Day\-to\-day tasks include lead generation through research, calls, emails, and networking, maintaining and updating client databases, and assisting in preparation of proposals, presentations, and quotations.
 



  





**Qualifications** 



* Candidates should possess skills in New Business Development and Lead Generation to identify and pursue potential clients and opportunities.
* Candidates should possess effective Communication skills, including clear verbal and written communication and professional client interaction.
* Basic understanding or interest in engineering, chemical, petrochemical, refinery, or oil \& gas domains will be beneficial.
* Motivated fresh graduates are encouraged to apply.
* Proficiency in MS Office tools (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and comfort with using CRM or lead\-tracking tools is an advantage.

title: Field Sales Executive
description:
**Padmansha Technologies Pvt Ltd.** 
 is leading manufacturer and exporter of Digital Pump Controllers. We are looking for a dynamic
 **Sales Executive** 
 to drive business growth and expand our dealer network across
 **Pune, Nashik, Mumbai and Maharashtra.** 
**This is a field\-based position** 
 ideal for someone with 3–4 years of hands\-on sales experience, strong communication skills, and a proven track record in building and nurturing dealer relationships.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 



* Develop and manage a robust network of dealers and distributors.
* Conduct regular field visits to prospects and existing partners.
* Achieve sales targets through effective market outreach and relationship management.
* Promote products and services with persuasive communication and presentations.
* Gather market feedback and competitor insights to support strategy.



 What We’re Looking For
 


* **3–4 years of experience** 
 in sales, preferably in industrial products.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong ability to build and maintain dealer networks.
* Self\-motivated, proactive, and comfortable working independently in the field.
* Valid driving license and
 **willingness to travel frequently** 
 .



 Why Join Us?
 


* Opportunity to work with a growing brand in a fast\-paced environment.
* Attractive incentives and growth prospects.
* Supportive team and hands\-on leadership.



 Job Type: Full\-time
 



 Benefits:
 


* Paid time off
* Provident Fund



 Location \- Dombivli
